method: Percentile = share of same-house seats in this state with a lower value (0 = lowest, 100 = highest). Metrics: winner vote share, margin (winner % minus runner-up %), turnout. Band (label, not a forecast): close = margin under 5 pp; marginal = margin 5 to 10 pp, or the same party lost 5 pp or more of vote share since the previous Lok Sabha election; comfortable = otherwise. Where no comparable previous share exists (MLAs: the 2017 page has no vote share), the band uses margin only. Trend compares the same party, so it is not a candidate record.
